artists.name: LT Drifta
bio: LT Drifta builds worlds from broken rhythm and late-night haze — jungle breaks colliding with hip-hop weight, cassette grit meeting digital precision.
As a core voice of VCR Recordings, the project moves between club pressure and headphone intimacy.

artists.name: Leftwave
bio: Leftwave arrives as a quieter current inside the VCR ecosystem — textures first, rhythm second, emotion always close to the surface.

artists.name: Miles Hale
bio: Miles Hale works at the edges of electronic form — producer instincts meeting artist intuition.
